import math
import factors


def factor_trend_score(bars):
    """Blend of price-vs-50d-mean, 60d momentum and EMA ratio: positive = healthy uptrend."""
    c = bars["close"]
    if len(c) < 60:
        return float("nan")
    ma50 = factors.ma_ratio(bars, n=50)
    roc60 = factors.roc(bars, n=60)
    ema20 = factors.ema_ratio(bars, n=20)
    if any(math.isnan(x) for x in (ma50, roc60, ema20)):
        return float("nan")
    return 0.5 * ma50 + 0.3 * roc60 + 0.2 * ema20


def decide(bars, account):
    c = bars["close"]
    n = len(c)
    if n < 60:
        return "HOLD"

    price = c[-1]
    arr = factors.arr(bars, "close")
    ma20 = factors.sma(arr, 20)
    ma50 = factors.sma(arr, 50)
    ma50_prev = factors.sma(arr[:-10], 50) if n > 60 else float("nan")
    roc20 = factors.roc(bars, n=20)
    ma50_ratio = factors.ma_ratio(bars, n=50)

    if any(math.isnan(x) for x in (ma20, ma50, roc20, ma50_ratio)):
        return "HOLD"

    above_ma20 = price > ma20
    above_ma50 = price > ma50
    mom_pos = roc20 > 0.0

    trend_ok = above_ma20 or mom_pos
    slow_ok = above_ma50

    # Trend-conditioned breakdown stop: exit when price is far below its 50-day
    # mean, or when the 50-day mean is falling and price sits below it.
    ma50_falling = (not math.isnan(ma50_prev)) and (ma50 < ma50_prev)
    breakdown = (ma50_ratio < -0.15) or (ma50_falling and not above_ma50)

    if account["position"] == 0:
        deep_below = ma50_ratio < -0.08
        if trend_ok and not deep_below:
            return ("BUY", "entry: trend_ok=%s deep_below=%s roc20=%.3f ma50r=%.3f" % (trend_ok, deep_below, roc20, ma50_ratio))
        return "HOLD"
    else:
        if breakdown:
            return ("SELL", "exit: breakdown ma50r=%.3f ma50_falling=%s" % (ma50_ratio, ma50_falling))
        if (not trend_ok) and (not slow_ok):
            return ("SELL", "exit: trend_ok=%s slow_ok=%s roc20=%.3f" % (trend_ok, slow_ok, roc20))
        return "HOLD"

import math
import factors


def factor_trend_score(bars):
    """Blend of price-vs-50d-mean, 60d momentum and EMA ratio: positive = healthy uptrend."""
    c = bars["close"]
    if len(c) < 60:
        return float("nan")
    ma50 = factors.ma_ratio(bars, n=50)
    roc60 = factors.roc(bars, n=60)
    ema20 = factors.ema_ratio(bars, n=20)
    if any(math.isnan(x) for x in (ma50, roc60, ema20)):
        return float("nan")
    return 0.5 * ma50 + 0.3 * roc60 + 0.2 * ema20


def decide(bars, account):
    c = bars["close"]
    n = len(c)
    if n < 60:
        return "HOLD"

    price = c[-1]
    arr = factors.arr(bars, "close")
    ma20 = factors.sma(arr, 20)
    ma50 = factors.sma(arr, 50)
    roc20 = factors.roc(bars, n=20)

    if any(math.isnan(x) for x in (ma20, ma50, roc20)):
        return "HOLD"

    above_ma20 = price > ma20
    above_ma50 = price > ma50
    mom_pos = roc20 > 0.0

    # Single fast trend gate: stay long while short-term trend OR momentum is
    # intact, with the 50-day mean as a slow backstop. This keeps us in the
    # stock through ordinary pullbacks (the source of the missed rally) and
    # only exits on a genuine break of both short-term signals.
    trend_ok = above_ma20 or mom_pos
    slow_ok = above_ma50

        if trend_ok and slow_ok:
            return ("BUY", "entry: above_ma20=%s mom_pos=%s above_ma50=%s roc20=%.3f" % (above_ma20, mom_pos, above_ma50, roc20))
        return "HOLD"
    else:
        # Exit only when both the fast gate and the slow backstop fail.
        if (not trend_ok) and (not slow_ok):
            return ("SELL", "exit: trend_ok=%s slow_ok=%s roc20=%.3f" % (trend_ok, slow_ok, roc20))
        return "HOLD"

import math
import factors


def factor_trend_score(bars):
    """Blend of price-vs-50d-mean, 60d momentum and EMA ratio: positive = healthy uptrend."""
    c = bars["close"]
    if len(c) < 60:
        return float("nan")
    ma50 = factors.ma_ratio(bars, n=50)
    roc60 = factors.roc(bars, n=60)
    ema20 = factors.ema_ratio(bars, n=20)
    if any(math.isnan(x) for x in (ma50, roc60, ema20)):
        return float("nan")
    return 0.5 * ma50 + 0.3 * roc60 + 0.2 * ema20


def decide(bars, account):
    c = bars["close"]
    n = len(c)
    if n < 60:
        return "HOLD"

    price = c[-1]
    arr = factors.arr(bars, "close")
    ma20 = factors.sma(arr, 20)
    ma50 = factors.sma(arr, 50)
    roc20 = factors.roc(bars, n=20)

    if any(math.isnan(x) for x in (ma20, ma50, roc20)):
        return "HOLD"

    above_ma20 = price > ma20
    above_ma50 = price > ma50
    mom_pos = roc20 > 0.0

    # Entry unchanged: short-term strength confirmed by the longer trend filter.
    enter = above_ma50 and (above_ma20 or mom_pos)
    # Exit only on a DEEP trend break or a sharp momentum break, so ordinary
    # pullbacks inside an uptrend no longer eject us into cash.
    deep_break = price < ma50 * 0.97
    sharp_mom = roc20 < -0.12
    exit_now = deep_break or sharp_mom

    if account["position"] == 0:
        if enter:
            return ("BUY", "entry: above_ma50=%s above_ma20=%s roc20=%.3f" % (above_ma50, above_ma20, roc20))
        return "HOLD"
    else:
        if exit_now:
            return ("SELL", "exit: deep_break=%s sharp_mom=%s roc20=%.3f" % (deep_break, sharp_mom, roc20))
        return "HOLD"

v001initial · written 2024-11-01 (2024-W44) · parent -live 2024-11-01 → 2024-11-15 (11 sessions): +0.00% vs buy & hold +36.11% (alpha -36.11 pp)
TSLA is a high-beta momentum name, so I use a trend-following core: enter when price is above its 50-day average and medium-term momentum (60-day ROC) is positive, confirmed by a rising 20-day EMA ratio, and exit on a close below the 50-day average or a sharp momentum breakdown. I add a volatility filter (ATR ratio) to avoid entering during chaotic expansions and a drawdown stop to protect gains. I would switch to mean-reversion if backtests show trend signals whipsawing, or loosen the trend filter if it misses too many rallies.
import math
import factors


def factor_trend_score(bars):
    """Blend of price-vs-50d-mean, 60d momentum and EMA ratio: positive = healthy uptrend."""
    c = bars["close"]
    if len(c) < 60:
        return float("nan")
    ma50 = factors.ma_ratio(bars, n=50)
    roc60 = factors.roc(bars, n=60)
    ema20 = factors.ema_ratio(bars, n=20)
    if any(math.isnan(x) for x in (ma50, roc60, ema20)):
        return float("nan")
    return 0.5 * ma50 + 0.3 * roc60 + 0.2 * ema20


def factor_vol_regime(bars):
    """Short vs long ATR: >1 means volatility expanding, a risk-off signal."""
    v = factors.atr_ratio(bars, short=5, long=20)
    return v


def factor_pullback_health(bars):
    """Close location and up-day share: measures whether recent bars are being bought."""
    clv = factors.clv_mean(bars, n=10)
    up = factors.up_day_ratio(bars, n=20)
    if math.isnan(clv) or math.isnan(up):
        return float("nan")
    return clv + (up - 0.5)


def decide(bars, account):
    c = bars["close"]
    n = len(c)
    if n < 60:
        return "HOLD"

    price = c[-1]
    ma50 = factors.sma(factors.arr(bars, "close"), 50)
    trend = factor_trend_score(bars)
    vol = factor_vol_regime(bars)
    health = factor_pullback_health(bars)
    dd = factors.drawdown(bars, n=120)
    roc20 = factors.roc(bars, n=20)

    if any(math.isnan(x) for x in (ma50, trend, vol, health, dd, roc20)):
        return "HOLD"

    above_ma = price > ma50
    trending = trend > 0.0
    calm = vol < 1.35
    healthy = health > -0.15

    if account["position"] == 0:
        if above_ma and trending and calm and healthy and roc20 > -0.05:
            return ("BUY", "uptrend: price>MA50, trend score %.3f, vol %.2f" % (trend, vol))
        return "HOLD"
    else:
        # exit on trend break, momentum collapse, or deep drawdown
        if (not above_ma) or trend < -0.02 or roc20 < -0.15 or dd < -0.22:
            return ("SELL", "exit: above_ma=%s trend=%.3f roc20=%.3f dd=%.3f" % (above_ma, trend, roc20, dd))
        return "HOLD"
